basic.name: Ancient Spear
basic.description: Throw out a spear that pulls Sonya to the first enemy hit, dealing 173~~0.04~~ damage and briefly stunning them. If this hits an enemy, generate 40 Fury.

basic.name: Seismic Slam
basic.description: Deals 176~~0.04~~ damage to the target enemy, and 44~~0.04~~ to enemies behind the target.

basic.name: Whirlwind
basic.description: Deals 138~~0.04~~ damage a second to nearby enemies for 3 seconds, healing for 25% of damage dealt. Healing tripled versus Heroes.

heroic.name: Leap
heroic.description: Leap into the air, dealing 135~~0.04~~ damage to nearby enemies, and stunning them for 1.25 seconds.

heroic.name: Wrath of the Berserker
heroic.description: Increase damage dealt by 40%. Reduce the duration of Stuns, Roots, and Slows against Sonya by 50%. Lasts 15 seconds, and extends by 1 second for every 10 Fury gained.

trait.name: Fury
trait.description: Use Fury instead of Mana, which is gained by taking damage or dealing Basic Attack damage. Using a Basic or Heroic Ability grants 10% Movement Speed for 4 seconds.

trait.name: Fury
trait.description: Use Fury instead of Mana, which is gained by taking damage or dealing Basic Attack damage. Using a Basic or Heroic Ability grants 10% Movement Speed for 4 seconds.

activable.name: Hearthstone
activable.description: After Channeling for 6 seconds, teleport back to the Hall of Storms, instantly restoring 1125 Health.

activable.name: Battle Rage
activable.description:
Activate to instantly restore 10% of Sonya's maximum Health. Stores up to 2 charges. Usable while Whirlwinding.

Passive: Sonya deals 25% more damage to Mercenaries.

activable.name: Nerves of Steel
activable.description: Activate to gain 25% of your maximum Health as a Shield for 3 seconds. Usable while Whirlwinding.

activable.name: Striding Giant
activable.description: Activate to become unstoppable for 2 seconds. Usable only when Wrath Of The Berserker is active.

activable.name: Ignore Pain
activable.description: Activate to gain 60 Armor for 4 seconds, taking 60% less damage. Usable while Whirlwinding.

level1.name: Furious Blow
level1.description: Every 4th cast of Seismic Slam deals 40% more damage to the primary target and costs no Fury.

level1.name: War Paint
level1.description: Sonya's Basic Attacks heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

level1.name: Tough As Nails
level1.description:
Every 16 seconds, gain 60 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 60%.

Stores up to 3 charges. Charges refresh 200% faster while Fury's Movement Speed bonus is active.

level4.name: Shattered Ground
level4.description: Increase Seismic Slam's splash damage by 250%. Targeting a Hero with Seismic Slam further increases its splash damage by 250%, while targeting other enemies increases the length of its splash by 66%.

level4.name: Hurricane
level4.description: Reduce the cooldown of Whirlwind by 2 seconds. Casting Whirlwind removes all Slows and Roots from Sonya.

level4.name: Shot Of Fury
level4.description:
Activate to gain 50 Fury. Usable while Whirlwinding.

Passive: After casting Seismic Slam, your next Basic Attack deals 40% more damage.

level7.name: Poisoned Spear
level7.description: Ancient Spear deals an additional 100% damage over 6 seconds.

level7.name: Life Funnel
level7.description: Increases the healing of Whirlwind to 35% of damage dealt.

level7.name: Battle Rage
level7.description:
Activate to instantly restore 10% of Sonya's maximum Health. Stores up to 2 charges. Usable while Whirlwinding.

Passive: Sonya deals 25% more damage to Mercenaries.

level10.name: Leap
level10.description: Leap into the air, dealing 135~~0.04~~ damage to nearby enemies, and stunning them for 1.25 seconds.

level10.name: Wrath of the Berserker
level10.description: Increase damage dealt by 40%. Reduce the duration of Stuns, Roots, and Slows against Sonya by 50%. Lasts 15 seconds, and extends by 1 second for every 10 Fury gained.

level13.name: Mystical Spear
level13.description: Ancient Spear always pulls Sonya to the target location even if it doesn't hit an enemy. When used this way, Ancient Spear's cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds.

level13.name: Ruthless
level13.description: Whirlwind deals an additional 50~~0.04~~ damage per second to Heroes below 50% Health. Does not generate additional healing.

level13.name: No Escape
level13.description: Increases the Movement Speed bonus from using Basic and Heroic Abilities to 20%.

level16.name: Giant Slammer
level16.description: Basic Attacks and Seismic Slam deal an additional 1.5% of Heroes' maximum Health as damage and heal Sonya for 60% of the damage dealt.

level16.name: Rampage
level16.description: Increase Basic Attack damage by 25%. Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Ancient Spear by 1.5 seconds.

level16.name: Nerves of Steel
level16.description: Activate to gain 25% of your maximum Health as a Shield for 3 seconds. Usable while Whirlwinding.

level20.name: Arreat Crater
level20.description: Leap leaves behind an impassable crater for 5 seconds.  Reduces Leap's cooldown by 20 seconds.

level20.name: Striding Giant
level20.description: Wrath of the Berserker increases maximum Health by 10% and grants Striding Giant, which can be activated to become Unstoppable for 2 seconds. 30 second cooldown.

level20.name: Composite Spear
level20.description: Increases Ancient Spear's range by 50%. Hitting an enemy Hero with Ancient Spear grants 25 Armor for 4 seconds.

level20.name: Ignore Pain
level20.description: Activate to gain 60 Armor for 4 seconds, taking 60% less damage. Usable while Whirlwinding.
